patch.value: Show declared decision requests in periodic standups
Present explicit human or agent decision requests with alternatives, response deadlines, canonical evidence and acknowledgment links.

Only declared requests appear; closed and superseded decisions disappear deterministically; private alternatives respect disclosure policy. Typed SDK and CLI provide bounded TOON/JSON with typed refusals and remedies; README and example; non-git public tracker validation; npm and Bun CI release gates.

value.text: Overlap rechecked against CLI 2026.10.21 and pinned SDK 2026.10.17: core plan decision stores text, rationale and evidence; pm-brief decisionsNeeded selects active Decision items for general context; pm-slack owns notification transport. No existing explicit decision-request standup contract was found. This feature owns periodic presentation and acknowledgment linkage only. Reconciliation PR #141 items are excluded. Plan: an explicit standup-decision-request tag plus a versioned declaration in the item body; public-only alternative disclosure, terminal/superseded suppression, deterministic bounded SDK and CLI reports, opt-in standup section, non-git regressions and public tracker copy validation. Dependency pins stay unchanged.
